startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: One or more public website URLs where the crawl begins. Example: https://example.com. Each seed keeps its own startUrl provenance. Same-hostname or same-domain links are followed up to maxPages.

crawlScope.title: Crawl scope
crawlScope.description: Which internal links to follow from each HTML page. same-hostname stays on the exact host; same-domain also follows subdomains; page-only fetches the start URLs and stops. Defaults to same-hostname.

maxPages.title: Max pages
maxPages.description: Hard cap on public pages fetched in this run. Example: 10. Default 100, maximum 2000. Prefill 10 keeps the first sample bounded. When useful in-scope URLs remain at this cap, the run finishes PARTIAL.

maxDepth.title: Max crawl depth
maxDepth.description: How many link hops from a start URL the crawler may follow. 0 means unlimited within maxPages. Default 10, prefill 3. Depth 0 is the start URL itself. Enable seedFromSitemap to add sitemap URLs as extra starts.

seedFromSitemap.title: Seed from sitemap
seedFromSitemap.description: When true, read robots.txt Sitemap entries and /sitemap.xml, then add in-scope URLs to the crawl queue up to maxPages. Defaults to false. Useful for coverage beyond the homepage link graph.

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: When true, skip paths disallowed for the crawler user-agent in robots.txt. Defaults to true. Turn off only for sites you are authorized to audit beyond the public robots policy.

ignoreUrlParameters.title: Ignore URL parameters
ignoreUrlParameters.description: When true, strip query strings before uniqueness so /page and /page?ref=nav count as one URL. Defaults to false. Enable for tracking-parameter cleanup; it does not rewrite canonical tags on the page.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel HTTP requests. Default and prefill are 5; maximum 20. Lower this for a rate-limited target. The crawler also applies a small same-domain delay for stable collection.

fetchMode.title: Fetch mode
fetchMode.description: Direct HTTP is the lower-cost default. Select residential Apify Proxy only for public sites you are authorized to collect when direct requests have repeatable rate limits; proxy platform costs can apply.

proxyConfiguration.title: Advanced proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional advanced Apify Proxy configuration. When supplied, it overrides Fetch mode. Use it only for public targets you are authorized to audit; it does not provide login credentials or browser rendering.
